sections.advice: Ouray → Telluride is 19 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Telluride → Lizard Head Pass climbs about 3116 m in 21 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Lizard Head Pass → Dolores drops about 3116 m over 80 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Million Dollar Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 40 km this is Million Dollar Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Million Dollar Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 3116 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Lizard Head Pass → Dolores
scenicChapters.narrative: 162 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

san-juan-skyway-ouray-dolores.story: A one-way ride of 245 km, Ouray to Cortez - roughly 3 h 22 in the saddle. The stops in between: Telluride and Lizard Head Pass. The highest point is about 3,450 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-synevyr-darvaika-wooden-churches-.story: From Kolochava it runs 276 km to Kolochava; allow about 4 h 46 of riding. It goes by way of Yasynia-Tserkva of Our Lord’s Ascension, Wooden Churches of Maramureş and back through Yasynia-Tserkva of Our Lord’s Ascension. The highest point is about 1,150 m. It crosses from Ukraine into Romania - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
